entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help with that. To pull up your account, could I please have your name and order number?

Thank you, James. One moment... I see your order for the VeloFit TerrainPro Mountain Bike Shoes, delivered 11 days ago. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
They don't fit. They gave me terrible blisters on my first ride.

Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters from new cycling shoes is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Did you get a chance to adjust the cleats or try a different insole?
I tried. They're just not right. I just want a refund.
I understand completely. Let me just check the return policy for you... one moment please.

Thank you for your patience, James. Okay, I've confirmed that your purchase is well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that for you. I've just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file.
Great. Should have been that simple from the start.

I do apologize for any inconvenience. And I see here you're a VIP member with us. To thank you for your loyalty and to make up for the trouble with these shoes, I've added a $25 credit to your account. Hopefully, we can find you a pair of cycling shoes that works perfectly next time.
You're very welcome. As soon as our warehouse receives the return, your full refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, James. Have a great rest of your day.
